profiles.plain_language_profile: Cluster 0 (34 training farms): low temperature, low fertilizer use, high field size. Average harvest 11.26 t; these farms are high-risk more often than the cooperative average (91% vs 50%).

Cluster 1 (32 training farms): high rainfall, low temperature, low soil moisture, high fertilizer use, low field size. Average harvest 12.45 t; these farms are high-risk less often than the cooperative average (9% vs 50%).

Cluster 2 (45 training farms): low rainfall, low temperature, high soil moisture, high fertilizer use. Average harvest 12.74 t; these farms are high-risk less often than the cooperative average (38% vs 50%).

Cluster 3 (42 training farms): low rainfall, high temperature, low soil moisture, low fertilizer use, low field size. Average harvest 8.18 t; these farms are high-risk less often than the cooperative average (40% vs 50%).
Cluster 4 (31 training farms): high temperature, high fertilizer use, high field size. Average harvest 14.31 t; these farms are high-risk more often than the cooperative average (84% vs 50%).
Cluster 5 (39 training farms): high rainfall, high soil moisture. Average harvest 13.40 t; these farms are high-risk less often than the cooperative average (44% vs 50%).

intended_use: Classroom decision-support prototype for a Musanze potato cooperative.
